system.description:
OPDQ: roll a Heart Check with CR equal to an enemy's CR +1. On a success it fights for you until death and counts as a companion (p51). Only 1 Mutineer at a time; the Director adjusts its Core Skills and abilities to suit its power.

SHIVER Core Rulebook p.54
system.summary: OPDQ: roll a Heart Check with CR equal to an enemy's CR +1. On a success it fights for you until death and counts as a companion (p51). Only 1 Mutineer at a time; the Director adjusts its Core Skills and abilities to suit its power.

automation.label: Target the enemy; CR = its CR +1
automation.onSuccess: The enemy is Beguiled: it fights on your side until death and is treated as a companion.

automation.note: On a success the Director hands the Mutineer to you as a companion and adjusts its Core Skills and abilities to suit its power. You can have only 1 Mutineer at a time.
